dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Origami arrived at MACC as an owner surrender. Origami's previous owner stated that he will lunge at strangers, children, and dogs while on leash. They also state that he will bark and growl when restrained. While in care, Origami has been observed to be fearful, noted to retreat from handlers, and show whale eye. Due to the detailed behavior, we recommend an experienced adult only home with no trips to the dog park.
dog.name: Origami
